reviews.name: Jeff Paadre
reviews.text:
5/5 stars, if you're debating it, just do it! The trip we took to Morocco was life-changing! The trip provided a great blend of city (Marrakech), desert (Agafay), and beach (Taghazout). We were able to take in a variety of experiences in such a short time. Logistics were completely taken care of; we got to show up and just enjoy a new country!

A big shoutout to our leaders: Sarah and Matas! They brought the vibes and helped a group of strangers instantly connect with one another.

I'll strongly consider taking another SYB trip ESPECIALLY if either of the two of them are leading!

reviews.name: Brian Rokeach
reviews.text: DO IT!   Just got back from SYB Morocco and....IT...WAS....AMAZING!!  Truth be told I was ambivalent about signing up as I'm on the upper end of the demographic, I'm an avid traveler on my own and I was questioning the price point a bit so I wasn't sure this would be for me.   My concerns couldn't have been more unfounded.   There was a wide range of ages on the trip (not that it mattered). The food, accommodations and activities were incredible. And I left with such a sense of community, fulfillment and joy that I'm genuinely struggling to return to normal life which typically is not an issue for me.   I can't say enough about the entire experience, in particular our "leaders" Katie, Daryl, Sam and of course Alex.   They made an epic experience truly unforgettable.  If I had to say anything even remotely negative it's that this might not be the trip for someone looking to do a deep dive into the culture and history of a country. However if you're looking for an easy, safe and fun way to travel to places you've always wanted to go while meeting incredible fitness focused people with open hearts and minds, I highly encourage you to try one out. I will definitely be planning another SYB trip!

reviews.name: Fabienne Ouwehand
reviews.text:
Morocco was already my third SYB trip and it was definitely as amazing as the other two and with the same mantras “you’re surrounded by love” and “don’t think just do”. Although the group was quite big (c. 50 people) I really had the feeling that I knew almost everyone at the end of the trip. SYB is able to create a safe space from day 1, from which deeper connections are built not only with the people around you, but also with yourself. It’s the combination of FUN, EXERCISE and MINDFULNESS that makes these SYB trips for me like no other trips I’ve been on.

In Morocco we had Africa burn-vibes desert disco (with a cool down in the swimming pool), camel ride, ATV, hot air balloon, 24 hours in Marrakech, champagne showers on the beach, morning runs through Taghazout, glamping in the desert, desert yoga etc. However, what always makes these trips so special is not so much all the fun activities, it’s the beautiful souls that decide to step outside their comfort zone and open themselves up to connect with new people around the world. The all stars, the desert queens, the don’t think just do rockstars. I feel blessed to be part of this amazing community and I can’t wait for my next SYB adventure!

reviews.name: Natalie Agudo
reviews.text:
Where do I even begin…
So I guess we can start with what brought me to Morocco and that was the amazing SYBe inspired foundation that was sponsoring 2 trips to healthcare workers and I was one of the lucky ones that was able to win the absolute magical trip to Morocco. Thanks to the beautiful soul Meag who interviewed me and vouched for me to be the winner of this trip I was able to have this life changing experience. I had never been on a retreat before and I had never traveled anywhere with strangers (let alone 52) and I can say that this was the absolute best decision I’ve ever made and the best trip I’ve ever taken in my life. Who knew I was going to come back home to NYC as a changed person in the best way imaginable. Surf yoga beer opened up my eyes and heart to the beauty of traveling, having fun, enjoying new experiences and meeting so many amazing like-minded individuals that I bonded with. All of us came from all over (both USA and Europe) and it’s like I was on a trip with my 52 closest friends. Even though I had just met them I feel like I had known them my whole life. I became happier, more open and in tune with my emotions, and more comfortable and proud of who I am as a person. Even though I was sad at the end because it felt like I was saying goodbye to the best trip of my life with the best people I am happy to say this is only the beginning and I will see you again SYB (and all my new friends ❤️).

& of course, a huge shout out and THANK YOU to the one and only Mantas for making this experience possible for not just me as the healthcare worker who was so fortunate to win this trip but to everyone who has had the life enhancing experience of going on an SYB trip. Don’t think, just do.

See you soon my friends,
Nat

reviews.name: Rachel Hale
reviews.text:
Deciding to travel internationally can always start with a bit of hesitation but with Surf Yoga Beer, that feeling will immediately go away. They provide everything you need from detailed itineraries, packing lists and introductions with the people you’ll be traveling with. The sense of community the founders and leaders of this company create is nothing short of amazing and they do it all while ensuring you get to enjoy and learn about the amazing country you’re visiting.

I recently went on the trip to Morocco with Surf Yoga Beer and left with such an appreciation for the country and also 52 new friends I know I’ll see again one day (probably on my next SYB trip).

If you’re contemplating booking a trip with SYB, do it and see for yourself how incredible it can be.

reviews.name: Lauren Smith
reviews.text: If Google had the option to give more than 5 stars, I would. Just returned from a week in Morocco through SYB and it was the trip of a lifetime! Started out knowing nobody and ended with 52 new friends and new memories to daydream about for years to come. The trip leaders were fabulous, ensured everyone was comfortable and having a good time, and it was a treat to have the packed itinerary organized ahead of time. Booked my next trip with SYB immediately upon my return home

reviews.name: Hope Davis
reviews.text:
It’s hard to put into words how amazing the SYB trips are but having now been on 2 trips: first to Croatia and second to Morocco, I think that speaks volumes.

Croatia was my first solo trip, I was a little anxious but my nerves were quickly eased with greetings from Steph & Mantas. From the carefully planned itinerary with some of the best experiences to the high energy workouts and reflective yoga sessions, I left the trip with some incredible memories, a refreshed outlook and friends for life from all over the globe. I also knew I had to book another trip immediately and Morocco also did not disappoint.

Being able see different parts of Morocco without the hassle of sorting transport was great and the surfing, exploring the medina, ATVing, camel rides and hot air balloons made the trip even better. And on top of that I got to meet another group of like minded individuals to make even more incredible memories with.

reviews.name: Bruce Crane
reviews.text: Awesome trip to Morocco! Exploring the markets and nightlife of Marrakech while making close friendships. Learning how to surf in the Atlantic Ocean to camel rides in the Sahara desert within a few days. Some amazing parties and amazing people come on these trips, and it is a great way to explore a country while meeting new people. Also great not having to do any of the planning and getting some great workouts in along the way. Made some great friends and can't wait to go on another trip!

reviews.name: Holly Anne Mitchell
reviews.text: I've done two amazing, adventure-packed and well orchestrated (food-yum, photographer traveling with you to capture all the IG worthy moments-check) trips with Surf Yoga Beer (Morocco and Iceland), and my life will never be the same. This fitfam community is fun, body positive, courageous, encouraging and full of genuine people who crave presence, adventure, and joy. In the modern age of digital disconnection, SYB aspires to a higher standard of human, body, and environmental connection. Don't walk--RUN--to their next event and remember their motto: Don't think, just do---get out of your head and into your body, into your one life, into this moment, because you never know what adventures await. Thanks SYB for all the memories; looking forward to making many more on future trips.
